title: Senior Process Engineer
description_text:
Senior Process Engineer
As a trusted partner for our clients, since 2004 Tri Innovations is committed to delivering a comprehensive range of Engineering and Construction Management solutions to the midstream energy, bulk handling, transportation, agriculture, and renewable industries. Our team of dedicated, agile, and efficient professionals is based in Calgary, Alberta, and has provided exceptional services to clients across North America.
We are a growing company with a culture based on teamwork and supporting each other's professional growth, all while having fun. Our team is made up of driven and dedicated professionals who care deeply about working together and make a positive impact. We are looking for a full-time Senior Process Engineer to join our team. If you want a challenge, and want to contribute to your professional growth, this is the place for you. If you see yourself on a team that upholds quality work, builds connections with fellow staff, contractors, and clients, and likes to have fun, then do not let a perfect opportunity pass you by. 
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Drive complex process designs, simulations, and documentation (PFDs, P&IDs, material balances) in compliance with industry standards and TRI’s quality management system.
Act as primary checker for junior and intermediate deliverables, rigorously verifying calculations and design parameters to ensure technical and safety integrity.
Align process requirements seamlessly with other engineering disciplines and project stakeholders across all project phases.
Identify and troubleshoot complex operational bottlenecks, edge cases, and safety risks using sound theoretical and practical engineering principles.
Mentor junior engineers and EITs, actively facilitating knowledge transfer and supporting their professional growth.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s Degree in Process or Chemical Engineering from an accredited university
Registered with APEGA, or registered with the provincial body as an engineer in another province in Canada, and eligible for registration with APEGA as a P.Eng.
8+ years of overall process engineering experience, with at least 5 years of experience in an EPCM environment
Documented capability to apply core chemical engineering principles, codes, standards, and TRI’s QMS to complex design work.
Track record of independent problem-solving, peer review, and the behavioral attributes required for technical anchoring and mentorship.
All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada, be a resident, and residing in Calgary or be willing to relocate to Calgary, to be considered for the position. We are committed to employment equality. 
We thank everyone for their interest in working with Tri Innovations; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Intermediate Process Engineer
description_text:
Intermediate Process Engineer
As a trusted partner for our clients, since 2004 Tri Innovations is committed to delivering a comprehensive range of Engineering and Construction Management solutions to the midstream energy, bulk handling, transportation, agriculture, and renewable industries. Our team of dedicated, agile, and efficient professionals is based in Calgary, Alberta, and has provided exceptional services to clients across North America.
We are a growing company with a culture based on teamwork and supporting each other's professional growth, all while having fun. Our team is made up of driven and dedicated professionals who care deeply about working together and make a positive impact. We are looking for a full-time Intermediate Process Engineer to join our team. If you want a challenge, and want to contribute to your professional growth, this is the place for you. If you see yourself on a team that upholds quality work, builds connections with fellow staff, contractors, and clients, and likes to have fun, then do not let a perfect opportunity pass you by. 
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop steady-state simulation models (e.g., HYSYS) to generate Heat & Material Balances (HMB) and evaluate process schemes. 
Calculate sizes and write specifications for standard equipment adhering to API/ASME codes and QMS standards. 
Create and maintain core engineering diagrams, including PFDs, UFDs, PSFDs, and P&IDs. 
Design process control strategies, logic narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and pressure relief systems. 
Perform field verifications and facility as-builting (5–10% field work) to preserve Process Safety Information (PSI) and asset integrity. 
Use CAD and data-linked platforms to maintain consistency across equipment lists, specifications, and drawings. 
Lead small-to-medium process packages from concept to completion in a multidisciplinary environment.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Degree in Chemical Engineering from an accredited university
Registered with APEGA, or eligible for registration, as a P. Eng.
6 or more years of experience in process engineering, ideally in an EPCM environment.
Proven ability to build long-term, collaborative relationships with clients and multidisciplinary project teams.
Exceptional time management and organizational skills to consistently complete project deliverables (reports, drawings, specs) on time and budget.
Practical proficiency in process & hydraulic simulations, and standard productivity software (MS Office/operating systems).
Demonstrable teachability and commitment to lifelong learning; actively seeking feedback and rapidly acquiring new skills, and methodologies to adapt to evolving project requirements.
All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada, be a resident, and residing in Calgary or be willing to relocate to Calgary, to be considered for the position. We are committed to employment equality.

title: S Process Engineer
description_text:
SALARIED POSITION DESCRIPTION

Job Title:             Process Engineer-Multiwall or Coating                                                       

SCOPE OF POSITION

Responsible for development of work methods, processes and operating procedures to improve quality, productivity and reduce waste.   Designs, observes, documents and evaluates trial runs and recommends modifications.  Assists in the start up of modifications and training of operators in their use

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBLITIES

Functional Responsibilities

 * Observes specific production runs for work methods, processes and operating procedures and documents what is taking place.
 * Designs and conducts experiments to establish relationships between control parameters and production results, both for quality and productivity.
 * Documents observations of trial runs, writes or assists in writing final report on trials and justifications for new equipment.
 * Proposes changes to methods, processes or procedures to improve quality, increase productivity, or reduce waste.
 * Analyses problematic runs and recommends possible causes and solutions.
 * Prepares performance specifications for new equipment. In conjunction with Area Foreman, Manufacturing Manger, Q.A. Technical sercvices and Production Manager, prepares Standard Operating Procedure manuals, especially with new equipment.
 * Assists with the start-up and trouble shooting of new equipment and documents comparison with performance specifications and results.
 * Keeps abreast of new developments through magazines and vendor contact.
 * Review new and change work orders and ECO’s for runnability, standardization and cost savings.
 * Reviews all complaints and manages complaint form responses.
 * Implement corrective actions in response to complaint.
 * Reverse engineer and design new product
 * Modify products though knowledge of raw materials and end use for cost reduction and/or performance improvement.
 * Understand and follow food safety and quality procedures

 

Managerial Responsibilities

N/A

 

 KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS




 * Frequent and regular contact with General Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Production Superintendent, Plant Engineer, Q.A. technical services and Production Supervisors to review problems, discuss possible solutions and new developments.
 * Regular contact with operating personnel to gather data on problem areas.
 * Occasional contact with Sales/Service Department for technical support.
 * Occasional contact with customers and outside testing agencies.
 * Occasional contact with government regulatory bodies or equipment suppliers.

 

FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 * Regular use of computers, telephones & misc office equipment.
 * Ability to meet deadlines.
 * Must organize complex tasks and meet deadlines.

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS

 * Periods of light physical effort required.  (ie. Occasional light lifting)

 

 WORK ENVIRONMENT

 

 * Conditions may cause minor discomfort due to limited exposure factors/elements.  Minor risk of injury to self or others.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

 * Technical Diploma or equivalent .
 * Knowledge and experience with computer systems

Minimum experience

 *  3-5 years experience in similar field

QUALIFICATIONS – SKILLS

 * Good people management skills
 * Project management skills
 * Computer literate
 * Strong understanding of various trades
 * Good oral & written communication skills Proficient in MS Office
 * Detail oriented

title: Senior Water & Wastewater Process Engineer / Project Manager
description_text:
What if you could redefine what’s possible? With us, you can.

With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science‑based
expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers.

We are WSP.

 

The Opportunity

Design What Comes Next

Join our growing Water and Wastewater team as a Senior Water & Wastewater
Process Engineer / Project Manager and play a pivotal role in delivering
infrastructure that supports healthier, more resilient communities across
Canada. As a trusted technical leader and project manager, you’ll guide
municipal water and wastewater treatment projects from concept through
commissioning while helping clients address today’s most pressing water
challenges. Working alongside a collaborative team of experienced professionals,
you'll combine technical excellence, innovation, and leadership to create
lasting impact for communities and the environment.

 

Your Impact

 * Champion health, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance across all phases

 * Lead multidisciplinary water and wastewater treatment projects from planning

 * Develop innovative process designs for municipal treatment facilities,

 * Mentor and develop junior and intermediate engineers, fostering technical
   growth and project excellence.
 * Collaborate with clients, partners, and internal specialists to deliver
   integrated solutions that create long-term value for communities.

 

The Skills That Set You Apart

 * 10+ years of experience delivering water and wastewater treatment projects,

 * Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, Mechanical Engineering, or a
   related discipline; a Master’s degree is considered an asset.
 * Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation, or eligibility for registration
   with APEGA.
 * Demonstrated expertise in municipal water and wastewater treatment processes,
   facilities, and associated infrastructure.
 * Strong technical writing and proposal development skills, with the ability to

   multidisciplinary teams in a consulting environment.

   and project locations.

 

Why Choose WSP?

advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

#WeAreWSP

 

Compensation

AB, BC, NT, NU, SK & YT: $104,100 - $138,000 

MB & ON: $95,000 - $130,800 

NB, NL, NS, PE & QC: $94,100 - $124,900

location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The wage range
provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

 

Ready to Shape the Future of Water?

Bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team
delivering essential water infrastructure that strengthens communities across
Canada. At WSP, you'll help solve complex challenges, influence the future of
sustainable water solutions, and create meaningful impact alongside
industry-leading professionals. If you're ready to lead transformative projects
and accelerate your career, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and help design what comes next.

title: Manufacturing Process Engineer
description_text:
Our team at Blackline Safety is growing! As a people-driven technology company, with a mission to make sure every worker returns home safely, we drive innovation, practice resiliency, demonstrate leadership, go the extra mile for our customers, and empower our people to be their best. 
The Manufacturing Process Engineer plays a key part in driving new product delivery, maintaining the operational gains achieved through continuous improvement, and in accelerating continuous improvement projects. From assisting with our circuit board manufacturing all the way though to manufacturing and service, the Manufacturing Process Engineer works with multiple disciplines and be focused on the daily productivity improvement activities required to sustain rapid growth and support new products.
Please note that this role is to cover for a maternity leave. 
Key Responsibilities
Act as a champion for continuous improvement activities to increase yield, throughput, and productivity in multiple manufacturing lines, and own their ongoing technical health
Engage with Product Development, Quality and other disciplines to complete root-cause analyses of issues in product or process and ensure resolution
Create documentation, procedures, and design processes to standardize manufacturing operations
Coordinate the implementation of engineering changes in production
Develop or source fixturing, tools, and other equipment to aid in manufacturing tasks
Complete time studies and manufacturing process line design audits identify gaps from standards and drive process improvement opportunities
Drive manufacturing process readiness for new product introduction launches
About You 
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical, or Manufacturing Engineering (or related field)
Minimum 7 years' experience in manufacturing or process engineering
Experience in manufacturing line design, operations project management, and new product launches
Excellent mechanical, electronics, and process troubleshooting skills
Experience with gas detection, PCBA manufacturing, injection molding, radio technologies, gas detection, and metalwork are all assets
Data acquisition and analysis experience using databases is an asset (MySQL, Power BI)
Familiarity with SolidWorks or other CAD tools
Ability to rapidly prioritize and balance conflicting priorities
Experience in a Lean Manufacturing environment and Six Sigma certification
Exceptional ability to communicate in English, verbally and in writing
Safety Shoe Requirement: This position requires the use of CSA Grade 1 toe protection safety footwear. Applicants must have access to a pair of safety footwear that meets this requirement prior to starting employment.
Total Rewards 
At Blackline Safety, we offer more than just a job—we offer a career with purpose. Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to support the diverse needs of our global workforce and vary based on employment type and location. They may include: 
Competitive base salary and annual compensation review 
Comprehensive health and dental benefits* 
Mental health and wellness support 
Flexible work arrangements and hybrid work model for eligible positions 
Paid vacation, personal and sick days* 
Professional development opportunities 
Education funding 
A collaborative, inclusive, and mission-driven culture 
Exclusive access to perks and discounts 
A flexible ‘Dress for Your Day’ environment 
*Eligibility and coverage vary by employment type and region. 
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 
Blackline Safety is powered by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants, regardless of age, religion, race, color, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, disability, national origin, race, or sexual orientation. We enthusiastically encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.
If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us at careers@blacklinesafety.com. We are committed to ensuring an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates. 
Join Us 
If you’re passionate about technology, safety, and making a difference, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help us build a safer, more connected world. 
Unauthorized Recruitment Communication Alert 
We are aware of the instances in which individuals are receiving fraudulent job offers or interview requests that are fraudulently alleged to be from Blackline Safety. 
Blackline Safety does not request payment or personal financial information at any stage of the recruitment process.
Please exercise caution, and do not respond to emails or other communications that are not from a Blackline Safety email address.

title: Process Engineer
description_text:
Job Description



VICTAULIC  



Process Engineer

Nephi, UT | Horizon Foundry Facility

Full-time

Manufacturing



Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other
work visa sponsorship) for this position 



ABOUT VICTAULIC  

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in
mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and
engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers,
site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved
construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed
safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+
locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies
and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range
of industries.  



Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote
circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and
minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in
more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and
prestigious structures.  



An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation  

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our
people.  



Let’s Build a Better World Together.  

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:  

 * We build from within.  

 * We stand behind our people.  

 * We foster an environment for constant learning.  

 * We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.  



YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

As a Process Engineer at our Nephi, UT Foundry, you will play a critical role in
driving operational excellence across our manufacturing processes. In this
position, you will analyze production performance, identify opportunities to
improve safety, quality, efficiency, and cost, and implement solutions that make
a measurable impact on daily operations. Working closely with production,
maintenance, quality, and engineering teams, you will help optimize foundry
processes, support continuous improvement initiatives, and introduce innovative
approaches that enhance productivity and product performance. Your expertise
will directly contribute to building a safer, more efficient operation while
helping deliver the high-quality products our customers rely on every day.



WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN 

 * Ensure all employees understand and abide by all Company safety rules,
   regulations, and policies.  Ensure that safe and sanitary working conditions
   are maintained in the facility in accordance with Company standards, as well
   as, state & federal laws and regulations.  Ensure all employees understand
   their OSHA rights.  Conduct safety training topics as required or needed. 
   Responsible for scheduling employees to attend all assigned safety meetings,
   toolbox talks, and safety training sessions.  Promptly investigate all
   accidents and near misses, completing appropriate reports and taking action
   to eliminate root causes.
 * Responsible for leading internal and external ISO Audits
 * Handle Quality Issues, Warranty claims, and Corrective Action responses
 * Manage controlled documents
 * Oversee and coordinate New Equipment installations
 * Design or modify equipment/processes to support maintenance and production
   requirements
 * Prepare part prints for fabrication and work with outside vendors to secure
   bids
 * Prepare and submit CPRs along with applicable documents for capital purchases
 * Assist and/or coordinate scrap reduction initiatives
 * Collect and Analyze data to improve processes and maintain process control
 * Support and actively participate in the Quality Improvement Process and
   Facility Excellence (FEM)
 * Work with other foundry and engineering groups to improve processes,
   equipment and reduce costs



WHAT YOU BRING  

 * B.S. degree in Metallurgical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent bachelor
   degree
 * Experience in design and construction methods and corresponding costs
 * Understanding of CAD/CAM use and application of foundry processes.
 * Ability to direct a cost control program (i.e. scrap analysis, process
   capability)
 * Good communication skills to interface with customers and suppliers



WHAT WE OFFER  

Build A Better Career  

 * Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives  

 * Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from
   within  

 * Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities  



Build A Better Future  

 * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage  

 * Retirement savings plans with company match  

 * Life insurance and disability coverage  



Build A Better You  

 * Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable  

 * Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources  

 * Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another  



Build A Better World  

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built
environment every day.  

  

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP  

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other
work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently
authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the
need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.  



EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY  

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer
and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and
impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion,
national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic
data, or other legally protected status. (Background checks may be required as
part of our pre-employment process).  



VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY  

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any
Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition
team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed
through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with
this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the
current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before
any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a
permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and
compliant recruitment process.  

  

Let’s Build a Better World Together.  

victaulic.com/careers

title: Principal Process Engineer
description_text:
Building on our past. Ready for the future Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now. 
Purpose 
We are currently recruiting for a Lead Process Engineer (SAGD) to join our team of world-class experts and project leaders. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and coordination for process engineering activities on SAGD and thermal oil sands projects, supporting projects from early studies through detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and start-up. The Lead Process Engineer will be responsible for overseeing process engineering deliverables, coordinating multidisciplinary interfaces, mentoring team members, and ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements. This is a full-time position based in either Calgary, Alberta or Edmonton, Alberta. 
Responsibilities
Lead process engineering activities on SAGD projects and ensure delivery of quality engineering services that meet Worley, customer, and regulatory requirements, on time and within budget.
Plan, coordinate, and oversee process engineering work performed by project teams.
Act as the primary process engineering focal point for assigned projects.
Manage process engineering scope, schedule, priorities, and technical deliverables.
Ensure process engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with project requirements, applicable standards, and established quality procedures.
Lead or oversee development and review of:
Process simulations and heat & material balances
Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
Process design criteria and philosophies
Equipment specifications and datasheets
Relief system design and operating envelopes
Engineering studies, reports, and technical documentation
Provide technical leadership during feasibility studies, conceptual design, FEED, detailed engineering, and brownfield modifications.
Support project planning activities including estimates, proposals, schedules, staffing plans, and execution strategies.
Identify and manage technical risks, scope changes, and engineering issues throughout project execution.
Provide technical guidance during procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, start-up, and operational support activities.
Participate in client meetings, design reviews, HAZOPs, risk reviews, and project decision-making processes.
Coordinate effectively with other engineering disciplines, project management, customers, vendors, and stakeholders.
Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to junior, intermediate, and senior engineers.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and promote engineering excellence across the organization.
Technical and Industry Experience
Extensive process engineering experience within the oil and gas industry, including significant SAGD and thermal oil sands project experience.
Strong technical knowledge of SAGD facilities and associated processing systems, including steam generation, produced water treatment, oil treating, gathering systems, utilities, and supporting infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience leading process engineering activities on multidisciplinary engineering projects.
Excellent understanding of process engineering fundamentals and design principles.
Strong knowledge of applicable industry standards, codes, regulations, and engineering best practices.
Experience supporting projects through all phases of execution, including studies, FEED, detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and start-up.
Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical challenges and provide sound engineering judgement.
Experience reviewing and approving process engineering deliverables.
Competent use of process engineering software such as Aspen HYSYS and other engineering analysis tools.
Strong communication, collaboration, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience leading technical teams and mentoring engineers.
Education, Qualifications, Accreditation, Training Required:
Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
Experience leading process engineering teams within an EPCM or consulting environment.
Experience serving as Process Lead on large multidisciplinary SAGD projects.

Stantec is seeking a Process Engineer in Training (EIT) to join our team to engage in projects across the full project lifecycle from concept selection through detailed engineering. As a Process EIT, you will contribute to multidisciplinary projects under the leadership of a Senior Process Engineer, Process Lead or Team Lead. Your work will include evaluating process options, developing calculations and simulations, preparing process deliverables, supporting equipment and system design, and assisting with field, construction, commissioning, and operational support activities. You will be expected to apply sound engineering judgment, follow applicable codes and standards, adhere to Stantec quality and safety procedures, and develop a strong foundation in safe, practical, and cost-effective process design. As part of the project team, complete technical tasks and deliverables such as: 
Developing process simulations, heat and material balances, utility balances, hydraulic calculations, and supporting design calculations.
Preparing studies, design basis documents, equipment specifications, performance specifications, and technical evaluations for process equipment and unit operations.
Developing, updating, and checking process engineering drawings, including PFDs, P&IDs, utility flow diagrams, tie-in lists, and process sketches.
Performing adequacy checks, capacity evaluations, bottleneck assessments, and design reviews for new and existing process equipment and systems.
Completing sizing calculations for equipment, piping, control valves, relief devices, utility systems, and instrumentation, and maintaining clear documentation of assumptions, inputs, methods, and results.
Collaborating with process team members, other engineering disciplines, vendors, construction teams, commissioning teams, and clients to deliver technically sound, coordinated, and quality work products.
Strengthening technical knowledge through project work, mentoring, informal learning, and formal training, with increasing familiarity with applicable codes, standards, regulations, and industry practices.
Supporting client interface activities through clear communication, timely responses, well-organized work products, and positive professional relationships.
Perform fieldwork to verify existing conditions, collect process and equipment data, confirm tie-ins, review equipment installations, support site queries, and provide home-office support during construction, commissioning, start-up, and troubleshooting activities. 
Qualifications
Your Capabilities and Credentials
Basic knowledge of Process Engineering design with an interest in one or more of the following areas: SAGD, Gas Processing, Mineable Oil Sands, Refining, Conventional Oil and Gas, energy transition and low-carbon projects.
Basic knowledge of fluid mechanics, piping hydraulics, line sizing, pump hydraulics, pressure drop calculations, two-phase flow concepts, and utility system design is required.
Experience with hydraulic software such as AFT Fathom, AFT Arrow, AFT Impulse, or similar tools would be an asset.
Working knowledge of industry-related simulation software (HYSYS, VMG Symmetry Process, PROMAX, etc.) would be an asset.
Strong analytical skills and good attention to detail with the ability to recognize discrepancies.
Ability to participate and collaborate in a project team setting and to engage in creative and critical thought.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong customer service attitude.
Willingness to go the ‘extra mile’ to support projects, clients and fellow employees.
Self-motivated, eager to learn, receptive to feedback, committed to professional growth, and accountable for producing accurate, complete, and well-documented work.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent discipline.
New graduates through 3 years of experience.
The candidate must be registered as an EIT with any Canadian jurisdiction and working towards professional licensure.

Benefits Summary: Regular full-time and part-time employees (working at least 20 hours per week) will have access to health, dental, and vision plans, a wellness program, health care spending account, wellness spending account, group registered retirement savings plan, employee stock purchase program, group tax-free savings account, life and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, short-term/long-term disability plans, emergency travel benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional membership fee coverage, and paid time off. 

Temporary/casual employees will have access to group registered retirement savings plan, employee stock purchase program, and group tax-free savings account. 

The benefits information listed above may not apply to union positions because benefits for such positions are governed by applicable collective bargaining agreements.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description_text:
Fluor is one of Canada's top employers and is recognized globally as a leader in the Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Fabrication, and Maintenance industry. Our focus on innovation and providing cost-effective technology-based solutions is second to none. As we look to the future, we need creative, ambitious, and innovative professionals who can help us fulfill our purpose to Build a Better World. 
Fluor team members are at the heart of our success in executing projects safely, thoughtfully, and with the highest quality. If you value teamwork, empowerment in your career, and are eager to champion innovative and sustainable solutions to our clients, this opportunity just may be for you!
Job Description
The Senior Process Engineer is responsible for leading process engineering activities throughout the lifecycle of projects, from conceptual studies and FEED through detailed engineering, procurement support, construction, commissioning, and startup. This role provides technical leadership, develops process design deliverables, ensures compliance with client and legal requirements, and collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to deliver safe, efficient, and cost-effective solutions.
This specific role requires an aptitude for executing front-end engineering, including feasibility studies, concept selection, pre-FEED and FEED. Attributes seen as an asset include an independent ability to understand and anticipate client needs and develop a project execution strategy including scope of work to address those needs. In this role the employee serves as both a front-end study leader and a subject matter expert and may lead a team of process engineers and designers while supporting business development, project execution, and client engagement activities.
Industries of interest a plus:
Upstream oil extraction including bitumen mining and SAGD
Downstream heavy oil upgrading and refining
Energy transition technologies including renewable fuels, hydrogen and carbon capture
Electrical power generation
Water treatment systems
Emerging and novel technologies
Job Description:
May lead a team of several engineers to develop drawings and specifications for study, feasibility, Front End Engineering Development (FEED)/Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction (EPFC) phase project definition and/or execution
Develop and review process engineering deliverables including process flow diagrams (PFDs), P&IDs, heat and material balances, equipment specifications, calculations, and design basis documents.
Perform process simulations, equipment sizing, hydraulic analyses, relief system design, and process safety evaluations.
Interface with client representatives: project, planning, process and instrument engineers, operations and maintenance to align contract requirements and expectations
Interface with Fluor discipline engineers to support interdisciplinary drawings and specifications 
Train team members in client business objectives, project development process & methods, critical financial parameters, and technologies
Develop schedule logic and effort-hours budgets
Analyze and make independent recommendations regarding solutions to problems with varying complexity in accordance with organization and/or project objectives and guidelines
Organize and prioritize a variety of projects and multiple tasks in an effective and timely manner, set priorities, and meet deadlines.
Basic Job Requirements
Accredited four (4) year degree or global equivalent in Chemical Engineering
12+ years of processing engineering experience within an EPC environment
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or eligibility for registration.
Strong knowledge of process design, process simulation software, engineering standards, and process safety principles.
Demonstrated leadership, project execution, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with audiences that include but are not limited to management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitors
Ability to attend to detail and work in a time-conscious and time-effective manner
Other Job Requirements
Preferred Qualifications
Fluor Canada rewards hard work, knowledge, and commitment. Fluor offers competitive employee compensation packages, comprehensive benefit programs including Health, Dental and Vision Care, flexible spending dollars, group registered retirement program, parental top-up, education reimbursement, employee and family assistance programs, and much more. Fluor also offers several employee resource groups that aim to provide opportunities for professional and personal growth, improved wellness, and involvement in the community. 
At Fluor, we believe that overall wellness encompasses the four wellness pillars of mental, physical, financial and social. Upon these pillars we are committed to fostering a healthy, inclusive and psychologically safe workplace by creating awareness through knowledge building and communication while focusing on measurable outcomes.
Compressed work schedule: The Fluor Canada offices work a compressed work schedule offering every second Friday off. 
Salary is based upon experience. 
The market rate for the role is typically at the mid-point of the salary range; however, variations in final salary are determined by additional factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, relevant years of experience, geographic location, internal pay equity, and prevailing market conditions for the specific role.
Fluor uses artificial intelligence (AI) in its hiring process to review applications and identify qualified candidates. More information including contact information is available in our Applicant Notice when creating a profile on our recruiting platform.
Notice to Candidates: As required by some of our clients and projects, to the extent allowed by law, offers may be conditional upon consent and clearance of a satisfactory background check which could include, but is not limited to, a criminal records check, and confirmation of education, professional registration, employment history, and references.
While only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview, be sure to continually check our website for other related positions as they are posted. Are you ready to join us? We are looking forward to hearing from you today!
